name: dsh-agent-memory
description: **v0.15 temporal dimension** — 时效维（论文 Fresh at Decision, Stale at Action · arXiv:2610.18126v1）：`reviewAfter`（复查死线 · YYYY-MM-DD · 写入侧接受 `+7d`/`+2w` 相对写法并**固化成绝对日期**）+ `watchFor`（观察条件 1–8 条）。论文核心：**新鲜度有天花板**（`Pr[f 在行动时仍成立] ≤ e^(-λΔact)`）——决策时取证再充分也突破不了执行间隙 Δact 里的变化；精度分解 `A=(1-π)K+π[ρS+(1-ρ)L]` 把剩余风险归给**路由**（新信息能否到达决策）与**判断**。实测：索引「决策文本」只达 37.5% 的关键消息；索引「全部背景」达 100% 却带 89 条噪音；**决策时写的观察条件达 92.2% 且仅 20 条噪音**（少而准才划算）。⚠ 三条**刻意不做**：① **不建独立 router**（recall 本身就是路由器——命中即看见「它在等什么」，免费路由；等有尸体再补）② **不设默认死线**（判断不代填：主人偏好该永久有效、环境坐标该 30 天一看，同一默认值会同时错两边）③ **到期 ≠ 作废**（只 = 该重看，不做自动失效/归档）。渲染只凸显需警觉档位（已过期 / 7 天内到期），新设与未设留空。**退出判据**：新写入带死线的比例长期 ≈ 0 ⇒ 撤或改形，不留死字段。**v0.14 grounding dimension** — 记忆的「约定状态」（论文 Grounding Awareness, arXiv:2610.18684 移植）：`established`（主人明确说过）/ `proposed`（**我提的、主人未回应**）/ `scoped`（接受但限范围）/ `rejected`（主人否决过）/ 缺省=未标注。⚠ **刻意不做强制门**——论文默认「未授权 ⇒ 必须确认」，但本系统主人的授权模式是「给方向、我自己决定」（AGENTS.md §2.2），处处请示会直接违背该定调 ⇒ 移植的是**可见性**（让我不被自己的提议骗）而非拦截。论文读数：未接受提议被记成「已确认信息」高达 86–100%，且给更多提议内容反而放大未授权执行（0.26→0.53）。渲染只凸显需警觉的三类（established/未标注留空）。**v0.13 subject dimension** — 记忆的「关于谁」维度（`self`=关于我 / `master`=关于主人 / 缺省=通用）。与 v0.5 `role`（谁写的）**正交**，且刻意不同三条：① **不做准入**（标记不是权限墙——不改变任何条目的可见性，故无需总开关）；② 未设=通用，存量条目零迁移；③ **允许显式转移**（`update({subject})`，与 I10 相反）——role 转移改可见范围故禁止，subject 只是标记，禁止则几百条历史记忆永远无法标注。三处可见：`recall`/`memory_browse` 过滤、`memory_stats` 分档、速览与 auto-recall 渲染标记（通用层留空）。 Agent-driven long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: scoped memory (global + per-workspace), layered entries (fact/knowledge/episodic), **role dimension for multi-agent workbench** (role-stamped writes + role-policy retrieval admission), **value auditor** (read-only memory_audit + proposal log), **context-centroid injection** (auto-recall query = weighted recent-turns terms, not just the last message + hit-rate metrics), **compaction-pipeline evidence layer** (per-bucket verdicts `not-ended`/`no-sources`/`already-summarized`/`pending` + `<DSH_HOME>/memory-compress-trace.jsonl` + memory_health readout), time-bucket compaction (day→week→month→year), associative recall (related chains) + memory_relate navigation, auto recall injection (CJK bigram search, tail append) with **v0.10 quality gates** (session-level entry dedup + IDF term weighting + generic-word gate + min-top-score gate — 无相关记忆时静默不注入), **v0.11 evidence-access & storage-hygiene fixes** (recall/memory_browse render now surface entry ids — they were long present in the output schema but dropped at the render layer, leaving update/forget/memory_merge without an entry point; compaction checkpoints now key on a **day-granular title** so repeated compactions in one day merge into a single episodic entry instead of leaving parallel snapshots; memory_audit gained `summary_max_chars` so an over-budget summary is flagged even below the generic 12k threshold), agent-decided content. **v0.12 DREAM-derived usage attribution** (memory_audit's usage term is now rank-weighted — `Σ decay^pos` over the returned list position instead of a raw hit count, so the #1 hit and the #20 hit no longer count the same; computed at parse time from the existing `ids` order ⇒ historical traces need no migration; `attributed ≤ hits` always, i.e. it can only stop over-crediting, never inflate; usage stays out of bucket decisions by construction, verified on the live 1,444-entry library with 0 bucket flips; the scoring basis is surfaced in both the structured notes and the rendered text).
